title: The Word (Logos)
gist: John begins by saying that the Word was in the beginning with God, was God, and became flesh. In the Old Testament God's word creates ('God said... and it was so'), speaks through the prophets and is spoken of almost like a person; in Wisdom literature Wisdom is with God at creation. John says all of this has a face: Jesus.
original: Greek logos (word, reason); Hebrew dabar; Aramaic memra in the Targums.

passages.note: God speaks and creation comes to be.
'His name is called the Word of God.'
'The word of God is living and effectual.'
